chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Working with Mulato's Three Habaneros at the Mella Club
summary: He returned to music with Mulato at the Mella Club in Harlem, then a trip to Detroit.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: And it was back in New York when you got back into music, right?
Okay, tell me about that Macho.
Well, I always was enthusiastic about to organize something, so I start working with Mulato with the Three Habaneros, at the Mella Club.
And they had a restaurant, they called Mella, Mella Club, because in those days there was a revolution over Spain.
Mella, M e l l a.
All right, and how long did you work with him there?
With Mulato? I spend a good seven or eight months. From there we went to Detroit. We played the Buck Cardinal and then from there we came back. When I came back, Alfredito Valdes was here.
